segments.name: Cloud Memory Business Unit ("CMBU")
segments.description: Provides memory solutions for large hyperscale cloud customers and HBM for all data center customers.
segments.evidence: CMBU is focused on memory solutions for large hyperscale cloud customers, and HBM for all data center customers.

segments.name: Core Data Center Business Unit ("CDBU")
segments.description: Provides storage solutions for all data center customers and memory solutions for OEM data center, enterprise, and NeoCloud customers.
segments.evidence: CDBU is focused on storage solutions for all data center customers, including data center SSDs and NAND components, and memory solutions for OEM data center, enterprise, and NeoCloud customers.

segments.name: Mobile and Client Business Unit ("MCBU")
segments.description: Provides memory and storage solutions for the mobile and client segments, plus consumer-market DRAM and component DRAM and NAND.
segments.evidence: MCBU is focused on memory and storage solutions for the mobile and client segments.

segments.name: All Other
segments.description: Holds operations that do not meet the thresholds of a reportable segment.
segments.evidence: Our other operations do not meet the thresholds of a reportable segment and are reported under All Other.

revenueModel.text: Micron sells DRAM, NAND, and NOR memory and storage products through its business units to customers in data center, mobile, client, automotive, industrial, and consumer markets.
revenueModel.evidence: We sell our products through our business units into various markets in numerous forms, including components, modules, SSDs, managed NAND, multi-chip packages, and wafers.

changes.text: In fiscal 2025 Micron began reporting under four business unit reportable segments (CMBU, CDBU, MCBU, and AEBU), replacing its prior segment structure.
changes.evidence: We have the following four business units, which are our reportable segments:
